title: Who's Talking?
summary: Inspect a service running only inside your lab container.
description: Client-server communication commonly uses an address and a port. This training service is synthetic and bound only to the lab container. Query its health endpoint, inspect the response, and record the result.
learning_objectives: Use curl to make an HTTP request

workspace_seed.service-notes.txt: The local service listens on 127.0.0.1:8080. Try /health.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: The target is already running inside this challenge container. You do not need a public website.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Inspect `service-notes.txt`, then use `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:8080/health` to observe HTTP status and response body.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Create `evidence/service-check.txt` with `service=training-api` and `status=ready`. Verify the lines from the local `/health` response before saving them.

completion_explanation: You completed Who's Talking?. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: Private local-only services; no public Internet route.
